mapper.select: SELECT em.emp_id, em.emp_name, em.emp_comp_mail, em.hired_date FROM emp_mgt as em WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM em.hired_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND em.logical_del_flg = false AND em.resign_flg = false AND em.partner_comp_flg = false ORDER BY em.emp_id

SELECT em.emp_id, em.emp_name, em.emp_comp_mail FROM emp_mgt as em LEFT JOIN conduct_mgt AS cm ON em.emp_id = cm.emp_id WHERE cm.work_year_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND cm.work_year_month < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND (TRIM(cm.field_code) = '1' OR cm.field_code IS NULL) AND em.logical_del_flg = false AND em.resign_flg = false AND em.partner_comp_flg = false AND cm.comp_flg = false AND cm.logical_del_flg = false ORDER BY em.emp_id
